title: Cover Credit Against the Extended Days of a Keyturn Trip Booking
content:
A credit comes off the quote for extra time on a Keyturn Trip Booking for each extended day, where the guest's protection election for that trip stands active. The election is made under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan, and what is read is whether it stands active and the daily protection fees charged on it.

1. Where the trip's protection election stands active and the daily protection fees charged on it come to 800.00 USD or more, however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised, the cover credit is 14.00 USD for each extended day.
2. Where the trip's protection election stands active and the daily protection fees charged on it come to less than 800.00 USD, the cover credit is 9.00 USD for each extended day.
3. In every other case no cover credit is given.

### Which fees are counted

The fees counted are the daily protection fee lines raised on that election and those alone; a line raised on it for anything else — a young-driver protection surcharge, a level-change difference, an additional-driver fee, a deductible or a credit — is not a daily protection fee and is not counted.

The daily protection fee lines are counted however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised, so several such lines raised on different days are added together and none of them is too old to count.

### The bands

| The protection election standing on the trip | Daily protection fees charged on it | Cover credit for each extended day |
|---|---|---|
| Stands active | 800.00 USD or more | 14.00 USD |
| Stands active | Less than 800.00 USD | 9.00 USD |
| Does not stand active, or there is none | Any | None |

The level the election is written as makes no difference here; what is read is whether it stands active and what has been charged on it as a daily protection fee. The fee figure is reached rather than passed, so daily protection fees of exactly 800.00 USD give the higher credit of 14.00 USD.

*Hypothetical.* A trip whose protection election stands active with 1250.00 USD of daily protection fees charged on it carries a cover credit of 14.00 USD for each extended day. The same election carrying 410.00 USD of daily protection fees carries 9.00 USD for each extended day, and it still carries 9.00 USD where a further 500.00 USD stands on it as a deductible, since that line is not a daily protection fee. A trip whose election no longer stands active carries none, whatever has been charged on it.
